    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AddEmployeeController
    Controller for adding, editing, and deleting employees from the table.
    AddItemController
    Controller for user to change quantities of items
    AddMenuDrinkController
    Controller for adding, editing, and deleting drink menu items from the table.
    AddMenuToppingController
    Controller for adding, editing, and deleting menu toppings We keep this separate from the AddMenuDrinkController because toppings are simpler and don't have ingredients or types.
    BaseMenuController
    This is the controller for the base launch menu.
    CancellationController
    This is the controller for the cancellation pop-up window.
    CurrentOrderModel
    Model class for managing the current order, including drinks, toppings, associated prices, IDs, and checkout procedures.
    EmployeeController
    Controller for viewing the employee table and managing the add employee form's opening
    EmployeeModel
    Model class for managing employee-related data, including retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting employee records.
    EmployeesRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from an employee SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the employee SQL table.
    IDNameValDTO
    Generic data transfer object to store related data which fits into an ID-name-value scheme.
    InvEdibleRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from an inv_edible SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the inv_edible SQL table.
    InventoryController
    Controller for viewing the inventory page, changing items, and adding new items to inventory
    InventoryModel
    Model class for managing inventory related data, including edible and nonedible items.
    InvNonEdibleRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from an inv_nonedible SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the inv_nonedible SQL table.
    JoinMenuDrinksAndInvEdibleRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from a join_menu_drinks_and_inv_edible SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into this SQL table.
    JoinMenuToppingsAndInvEdibleRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from a join_menu_toppings_and_inv_edible SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into this SQL table.
    ManagerController
    Manages the opening of several pages which can be accessed by the manager on their specific interface.
    MenuController
    This controller manages the menu view, populating the drinks and toppings tables.
    MenuDrinksRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from a menu_drinks SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the menu_drinks SQL table.
    MenuModel
    Model class for managing menu-related data, including drinks, toppings, and their ingredients.
    MenuToppingsRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from a menu_toppings SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the menu_toppings SQL table.
    NewItemController
    Controller for user to add new items to the inventory database
    OrderHistoryController
    Controller for viewing orders based on filters (time period, alphabetical order, etc.) and voiding orders.
    OrderHistoryModel
    Model class for managing order history-related data, including drinks, toppings, associated prices, IDs, and the times at which each order was created.
    OrderLineDTO
    Data transfer object to store some data related to an order.
    OrderMenuController
    Controller for the order menu, allowing users to select a drink, toppings, sugar level, and ice level.
    OrdersRowDTO
    Data transfer object to store all data from an orders SQL table row, or create a structure to properly insert a new row into the orders SQL table.
    PGComms
    Manages all application related to the PostgreSQL JDBC driver.
